Also, today is 17 November, so an "October" shipment notice is odd timing, but I can't tell from the draft whether it's a late send or a scheduling quirk. Worth the team confirming, but it isn't a copy or claims issue I can verify.

- **"a smoky lapsang and a soft white peony"**: Product and flavour description, fine as written.
- **"you can pause or cancel any time from your account"**: Matches the approved claim that subscribers can pause or cancel any time.
- **Sign-off and tone**: Short, specific, and in a human voice. No clichés, no hype, no health, green, pricing or urgency claims. It's an email from the brand's own channel to a subscriber, so no ad label is needed.

Nothing in the draft needs changing. The only notes are optional: confirm the "October" wording is right given the send date, and decide whether "tins" or "box" is the preferred word.
